title: Admin Risks in practice
intro: More privilege, more responsibility. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Security keys for admin accounts

artifact.subject: Security keys for admin accounts
body: From Monday, admin panel sign-in requires a physical key. Collect yours in person from room 305.

decisions.explain: No link, nothing to download or type, the key is handed over in person. This change makes you safer.

decisions.title: Server password in a ticket

artifact.name: Ticket 4821
body: I put the server password in the comments so the next shift can see it.

decisions.explain: Many people see tickets and they stay in the archive. Rotate the password and move it to the vault.

decisions.title: Keys file in the repository
decisions.prompt: A colleague committed this file to the deploy repository. Is this a safe practice?
decisions.explain: The .env file was committed to the repository. Keys stay in history, so deleting the file is not enough. Rotate them now.

decisions.title: Admin password before a holiday

artifact.name: Kamran (network)
body: I am off on holiday, here is my admin password, use it if needed.

decisions.explain: With a shared admin account no one can tell who did what. The stand-in should get temporary rights on their own account.
